no_data_equivalence.evaluation_rule: Every threshold must pass; the time test requires both absolute-delta and ratio conditions. Accessibility measures requirement-fixture coverage only, with zero observed users and no usability-performance claim.
no_data_equivalence.field_replacement_trigger: Authorized E3 field test and E4 professional/operator confirmation replace synthetic inputs and may tighten or reject these design thresholds.

service_level_targets.public_return_closure: Use the due_at value written on each ticket; no uniform real-world duration is claimed.

implementation_envelope.gate_2_rule: Every blocker must be confirmed by an authorized source and all E3 field tests and E4 professional/operator confirmations must pass before any controlled live scenario.

synthetic_capacity_envelope.field_replacement_trigger: Authorized E3 demand and service observations plus E4 operator, accessibility and professional confirmation must replace or reject every synthetic input before Gate 2.

official_three_positioning.protocol_response: Rail ticket, timetable, waybill, punch and station clock become purpose permission, term, derivative chain, execution log and automatic expiry.
The same core service remains available through no-data, staffed, paper and offline routes.
Controlled compute is bound to explicit purpose, input, output, expiry, withdrawal and working-stop contracts.

official_five_functions.protocol_response: Controlled domain, approved query/model/container, execution log and output gate form one auditable stack.
A nine-role RACI opens bounded testing while preserving single accountability and unilateral stop authority.
SCN-06 turns controlled compute into a locatable, reversible and testable urban service scenario.
No-data equivalence and human takeover keep daily service open when optional data is declined or automation fails.
The bilingual machine-readable expiry-withdrawal-residual-return contract makes limits and failures portable for review.

agent_tasks.response: Connects one corridor-scale governance loop to a scenario and two supporting wings.
Defines a bounded full-stack controlled-compute and innovation-ecosystem contract.
Makes SCN-06 operable through explicit inputs, outputs, roles, thresholds and fallback.
Treats BLDG-002 only as a conceptual host candidate and keeps the public interface reversible.
Translates railway time and receipt language into legible governance without claiming historic fact.
Defines expiry, withdrawal, residual disclosure, return acceptance and closure as an annual operating evidence chain.

fail_closed_assertions.rule: The ticket state set and allowed transition set exactly match this protocol.
The execution state set and allowed transition set exactly match this protocol.
Every E2 rehearsal stays at SCN-06 / PROV-KEY-001 and transfers no ticket, data, role or stop authority to another node.
Every rehearsal instantiates every required ticket field, uses only synthetic controlled inputs, preserves unknown entity and legal assignments, and binds expiry or withdrawal events to its own term.
Every rehearsal event timestamp is valid and strictly monotonic; event-derived ticket and execution states exactly match complete initial-to-terminal sequences.
Every SLA target is exercised by at least one event-to-event synthetic observation and every elapsed duration is recomputed against the pinned target.
Expiry or withdrawal atomically enters stopping, immediately blocks every new query or output, permits teardown only, and reaches stopped within 60 seconds.
Every RACI activity has exactly one accountable role and every referenced role exists.
Every synthetic route pair passes every no-data equivalence threshold, including both time conditions.
All six accessibility tasks have valid paired-route synthetic fixtures and resolvable evidence; coverage is not usability performance and observed users remain zero.
No output may be released after expiry or withdrawal; the withdrawal case must deny its injected query.
Every expiry or withdrawal case discloses residual effects and never promises complete erasure.
Return acceptance requires a delivered bilingual public audit card, independently recalculated value meeting its target, resolvable evidence pointers, and an explicit not-observed impact boundary.
Every conditionally required artifact has one valid record whose minimum fields, role, state, timestamp and content pointers resolve against the case.
The protocol remains E2, with field, entity, professional and implementation states unconfirmed.
Every declared available unit, throughput, headroom and utilization value must be recomputed from the pinned 60-minute synthetic fixture.
Every C-01, C-02 route and C-04 model must retain non-negative headroom under the synthetic demand fixture.
The no-data route keeps two dedicated non-borrowable abstract units and at least the same synthetic throughput as the data route.
C-04 keeps one abstract unit outside live work for teardown and recovery; it is not a confirmed hardware or staffing reserve.
All real entities, staffing, site, engineering, cost, procurement and approval fields stay null or unknown and field operation remains blocked.

recalculation_contract.negative_test: The runner clones the two ticket cases and the synthetic capacity envelope in memory. It must reject all ten ticket mutations plus five capacity mutations covering a drifted calculation, demand above C-01 capacity, borrowed no-data units, a removed C-04 stop reserve, and a false field confirmation.
